# endorses

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:endorses`](gmeow-endorses.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/endorses>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)

A convenience shortcut recording that one agent vouches for another. Deliberately NOT symmetric (endorsement is directional) and NOT transitive (trust must not propagate inside the reasoner — that is the metric the perspectival [`TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) bounds). Use [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) for leveled, dated, perspectival trust.
